records.claim: A well-planned vegan diet can be health-promoting for healthy adults with reliable vitamin B12 supplementation and adequate nutrient intake.
records.limits: Limited evidence for children, pregnant/breastfeeding individuals, adolescents and older adults. Counselling advised.

records.claim: Unfortified plant foods do not naturally supply reliable vitamin B12; supplements and fortified foods are relevant.
records.publisher: US NIH Office of Dietary Supplements
records.limits: Nutritional guidance is not personalised medical advice.

records.claim: In a UK dietary study vegan diets had 25.1% of the greenhouse gas impact of high meat diets; 95% uncertainty interval 15.1-37.0%.
records.limits: Modelled environmental footprints of study groups, not individual proof or worldwide universal effect.

records.claim: A majority of global soy production is used as livestock feed; Our World in Data reports 77%.
